**Release cut 1.4.0 (#848)**

package.json 1.1.0 -> 1.4.0 so the three promoted-but-dormant migrations (sdd.stages 1.2.0, sdd.configs 1.3.0, sdd.engines 1.4.0) reach a consumer: migrateConfig applies entries only up to the installed PACKAGE version. README tags bumped (readme-version.test.mjs enforces). CHANGELOG entry written. Found: engines-cli.test.mjs hardcoded '1.1.0' as the expected package version — now derives from package.json. Also found: no v1.1.0 git tag exists (last is v1.0.0), so release.yml's audit window would be 304 merges instead of ~56; the 1.1.0 tree is 76c2ceaf. Audit over 76c2ceaf..HEAD: 43 PASS, 0 violations. Tarball rehearsal: 562 files, 1.7MB.
